'''IHS Markit''' (formely '''IHS Inc.''') was an information services provider headquartered in [[London]]. It was formed in 2016 with the merger of IHS Inc. and [[Markit]] Ltd.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=CNBC |date=March 21, 2016|url=https://www.cnbc.com/2016/03/21/ihs-and-markit-to-merge-in-deal-valued-at-more-than-13b.html|quote=IHS and Markit ... announced plans to merge |title=IHS and Markit to merge in deal valued at more than $13B}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=S&P Global and IHS Markit Complete Merger |url=https://press.spglobal.com/2022-02-28-S-P-Global-and-IHS-Markit-Complete-Merger |access-date=2022-09-23 |website=News Release Archive |language=en}}</ref> In 2022, IHS Markit completed a [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] with [[S&P Global]].<ref>{{cite news |author=Mark Harden |title=IHS, Markit shareholders OK $13B merger   |url=http://www.bizjournals.com/denver/news/2016/07/11/ihs-markit-shareholders-ok-merger-deal-set-to.html |access-date=July 13, 2016   |work=Denver Business Journal |date=July 11, 2016}}</ref>

==History==
===IHS===
Information Handling Services (IHS)<ref name="IHS1959B">{{Cite web|title=Information Handling Services (IHS) acquired USA Information Systems | Aviation Week Network|url=https://aviationweek.com/information-handling-services-ihs-acquired-usa-information-systems|access-date=January 9, 2020|website=aviationweek.com}}</ref> was founded in 1959, in [[Denver]], Colorado, as Information Handling Services to provide information for aerospace engineers through microfilm databases.<ref name="Picker">{{cite web|last=Picker|first=Leslie|date=March 21, 2016|title=IHS and Markit, Providers of Data and Analytics, Agree to Merge|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/22/business/dealbook/ihs-markit-deal.html|work=The New York Times}}</ref>

IHS subsequently grew to incorporate other companies in the information services sector such as [[Cambridge Energy Research Associates]], [[Global Insight]], [[Jane's Information Group]], Prime Publications Limited, and John S. Herold, Inc.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=Our History |url=https://www.spglobal.com/en/enterprise/about/history.html |access-date=27 Nov 2022 |website=spglobal.com}}</ref>

In 2008, IHS acquired [[Fairplay (magazine)|Fairplay]], a firm that assigns [[IMO number|IMO identification numbers]] for ships, companies and registered owners.<ref>{{cite web|title=IMO Identification Numbers for Ships, Companies and Registered Owners / About|url=https://www.imonumbers.lrfairplay.com/Home/About|access-date=August 19, 2018|publisher=IHS Markit}}</ref>

In 2016, [[Englewood, Colorado]]-based IHS and London-based Markit merged. Jerre Stead was chief executive of the pre-merger IHS Inc. from 2006 to 2013 and from 2015 until the merger with Markit.<ref name="Picker" />

=== Markit ===
[[Markit]] was founded in 2003 as Mark-it Partners, a financial data provider for daily [[credit default swap]] pricing.<ref>{{cite magazine|date=July 6, 2013|title=Plumbers in suits|url=https://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21580494-private-company-controlled-banks-connects-much-financia|magazine=The Economist}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|author=Natalie Harrison|date=November 14, 2007|title=Markit says buys IIC, agrees to buy CDS IndexCo|work=Reuters|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/mergersNews/idUSL1444559220071114|access-date=December 14, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite report|url=http://www.cdsmodel.com/assets/cds-model/docs/Interest%20Rate%20XML%20v1.3.pdf|title=Markit USD Interest Rate Curve XML Specification|date=March 30, 2009|publisher=Markit}}</ref> The company grew via [[joint venture]]s and by acquiring other companies,<ref>{{cite web|author=Dave Valiante|date=July 28, 2008|title=JPMorgan's FCS Corporation Acquired Indexes|publisher=Bloomberg|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/apps/news?pid=20601080&sid=awvPyvPEPnug&refer=asia|access-date=December 14, 2007}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|author=William Alden|date=May 5, 2014|title=Financial Data Company Markit Files for I.P.O.|work=The New York === S&P Global ===
On 30 November 2020, [[S&P Global]] and IHS Markit released information about a definitive all-stock deal{{clarify |reason=What kind of deal? |date=June 2023}} for around $44 billion, a deal that would be the largest of the year globally, according to [[Dealogic]] data.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hoffman |first=Cara Lombardo And Liz |date=2020-11-30 |title=WSJ News Exclusive {{!}} S&P Global Nears Deal to Buy IHS Markit for About $44 Billion |language=en-US |work=Wall Street Journal |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/s-p-global-in-advanced-talks-to-buy-ihs-markit-for-about-44-billion-11606697244 |access-date=2020-11-30 |issn=0099-9660}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=S&P Global and IHS Markit to Merge in All-Stock Transaction Valuing IHS Markit at $44 Billion, Powering the Markets of the Future |url=https://investor.ihsmarkit.com/news-releases/news-release-details/sp-global-and-ihs-markit-merge-all-stock-transaction-valuing-ihs |accessdate=2021-07-21 |publisher=ihsmarkit.com}}</ref> On September 9, 2021, [[GlobalData]] announced its purchase of the Pricing and Reimbursement dataset from IHS Markit.<ref>{{cite web |title=GlobalData buys drug pricing coverage business of IHS Markit|date=September 9, 2021 |url=https://newsnreleases.com/2021/09/09/globaldata-buys-drug-pricing-coverage-business-of-ihs-markit/}}</ref> In December 2021, the IHS Markit announced its intention to sell Base Chemicals to [[News Corp]] for a reported $295 million as part of an effort to alleviate concerns about competitive effects.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Grossman |first1=Matt |title=S&P Global, IHS Markit to Sell Businesses Ahead of Merger |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/s-p-global-ihs-markit-to-sell-businesses-ahead-of-merger-11640616651 |access-date=27 January 2022 |website=The Wall Street Journal |date=December 27, 2021 }}</ref> The purchase by S&P Global was finalized on 28 February 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Basar |first=Shanny |date=2022-03-07 |title=Embracing Change in a New World |url=https://www.bestexecution.net/embracing-change-in-a-new-world/ |access-date=2022-04-27 |website=Best Execution |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Acquisitions==
*10 October 1996: IHS Group purchased oil exploration company [[Petroconsultants]] following the death of its founder and president Harry Wassall in November 1995.<ref name=OilIT1998/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.peakoil.net/headline-news/the-first-ever-oil-database-the-history-of-petroconsultants |title=The first ever oil database, the history of Petroconsultants | ASPO International | the Association for the Study of Peak Oil and Gas |accessdate=2011-02-08 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110606161515/http://www.peakoil.net/headline-news/the-first-ever-oil-database-the-history-of-petroconsultants |archivedate=2011-06-06 }}</ref> This acquisition was later followed in January 1998 by the IHS Group acquiring the North American oil exploration company Petroleum Information / Dwights LLC.<ref name=OilIT1998>{{Cite news |title=IHS GROUP ACQUIRES PETROLEUM INFORMATION / DWIGHTS |work=Oil IT Journal |date=January 1998 |url=https://oilit.com/HTML_Articles/1998_1_1.php}}</ref>
* 18 September 2008: IHS Inc. agreed to purchase the economics forecasting organization [[Global Insight]] for $200 million.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Global Insight bought in deal worth $200m |date=September 19, 2008 |work=J.Y. Design Blog |url=http://www.jydesign.com/blog/2008/09/global-insight-bought-in-deal-worth.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081018222537/http://www.jydesign.com/blog/2008/09/global-insight-bought-in-deal-worth.html |archive-date=October 18, 2008 |access-date=June 16, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Global Insight bought in deal worth $200m: Waltham research firm now under IHS umbrella with Cambridge Energy |work=Boston Globe |date=September 19, 2008 |url=http://archive.boston.com/business/articles/2008/09/19/global_insight_bought_in_deal_worth_200m/}}</ref>
* 10 June 2013: [[R.L. Polk & Company]], a provider of auto-industry data including used-car history company [[Carfax, Inc.]], for $1.4 billion.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.autonews.com/article/20130610/RETAIL01/130619997/ihs-to-acquire-polk-in-1-4-billion-deal |website=Automotive News |access-date=9 November 2020|title=IHS to acquire Polk in $1.4 billion deal - Carfax makes up 60% of Polk's revenue, investors told|date=June 10, 2013 }}</ref>
* 26 September 2017: automotiveMastermind Inc., a provider of [[predictive analytics]] and marketing automation for the automotive industry.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20170926005531/en/IHS-Markit-Announces-Acquisition-automotiveMastermind-Leader-Predictive|title=IHS Markit Announces Acquisition of automotiveMastermind Inc., Leader in Predictive Analytics for the Automotive Industry|date=September 26, 2017|website=www.businesswire.com|access-date=January 9, 2020}}</ref>
* 26 September 2017: Macroeconomic Advisers, an independent research firm forecasting the US economy.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ihsmarkit.com/research-analysis/ihs-markit-acquires-macroeconomic-advisers-v2.html|title=IHS Markit acquires Macroeconomic Advisers|website=IHS Markit|date=September 26, 2017}}</ref>
* 3 August 2018: Ipreo, software solutions and data provider in global capital markets.<ref>{{cite magazine
   |magazine=Triangle Business Journal
   |url=https://www.bizjournals.com/triangle/news/2018/08/02/amid-ihs-markit-buy-nothing-changes-for-ipreos-250.html
   |title=Amid IHS Markit buy, 'nothing changes' for Ipreo's 250-job Raleigh expansion, exec says
   |author=Lauren Ohnesorge  |date=August 2, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20180802005490/en/IHS-Markit-Completes-Acquisition-Ipreo|title=IHS Markit Completes Acquisition of Ipreo|date=August 2, 2018|website=www.businesswire.com|access-date=January 9, 2020}}</ref>
* 10 October 2019: Novation Analytics, a specialist provider of software solutions, data analysis and advisory services.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/press-releases/2019-10-10/ihs-markit-acquires-novation-analytics|title=IHS Markit Acquires Novation Analytics|newspaper=Bloomberg.com|date=October 10, 2019 |access-date=2020-04-03}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.finsmes.com/2019/10/ihs-markit-buys-novation-analytics.html|title=IHS Markit Buys Novation Analytics|last=FinSMEs|date=2019-10-10|website=FinSMEs|language=en-US|access-date=2020-04-03}}</ref>
* 2019: Acquired [[Informa]]'s Agriculture Intelligence in exchange for most of IHS Markit's Technology, Media and Telecoms division (including [[Screen Digest]]).<ref>{{cite web|date=2019-05-24|title=IHS Markit swaps group that researches optical communications for Informa's agribusiness unit|url=https://www.lightwaveonline.com/business/market-research/article/14033814/ihs-markit-swaps-group-that-researches-optical-communications-for-informas-agribusiness-unit|access-date=2019-11-29|work=Lightwave}}</ref>
* 1 May 2020: Catena Technologies Pte Ltd, a global regulatory trade reporting firm based in Singapore.
